name: session-keeper
description: SessionKeeper from Ablation Lab: save your whole set of Claude Code sessions as a snapshot and restore it in one click (Windows).

plugins.name: session-keeper
plugins.description: Save your whole set of Claude Code sessions as a snapshot and restore it in one click with the SessionKeeper app, which also shows recent and running sessions and your other terminal windows. Claude gets a skill and commands to list sessions and snapshots, save a snapshot and open the app.
